name: @youraitools/agentkit-action-provider
description: Coinbase AgentKit action provider for YourAITools pay-per-call x402 APIs: PayGuard (OFAC screen), TokenVerdict (Base token safety), SmartPerps (Hyperliquid smart money), ToolPick (paid-API finder), WebRead (page to Markdown), InjectScan (prompt-injection scan). Pays per call with the AgentKit wallet only when enabled; spend-capped; no custody.
